title: A Unified Debiasing Approach for Vision-Language Models across Modalities and Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating demographic disparity in recall for zero-shot classification, measuring gender skew in text-to-image retrieval for neutral text prompts, calculating composite gender mismatch rates in image captioning using pronoun detection, and assessing skewed gender distribution in text-to-image generation for profession-based prompts.

Measuring the maximum discrepancy in classification probability across multiple racial and skin-tone categories (e.g., lighter, middle, darker skin tones) for zero-shot classification using the FACET and FairFace datasets.
